description: Source code for a firmware image utility that constructs firmware images with multiple blocks, including boot, config, web pages, and runtime code, for specific hardware boards. It includes argument parsing, file handling, checksum calculations, and block layout logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, processes blocks, and writes the firmware image file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the utility.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Parses the board option and sets the target board configuration.

methods.name: parse_opt_block
methods.description: Parses block options for adding firmware blocks (boot, config, web, runtime, extra).

methods.name: process_blocks
methods.description: Calculates layout and sizes for all firmware blocks based on input files and target board constraints.

methods.name: write_out_blocks
methods.description: Writes all firmware blocks to the output file.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration by model name.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns a base address to the specified alignment boundary.

methods.name: str2u32
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: str2u16
methods.description: Converts a string argument to a 16-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: str2u8
methods.description: Converts a string argument to an 8-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: str2sig
methods.description: Converts a 4-character string to a 32-bit signature value.

methods.name: parse_arg
methods.description: Parses colon-separated arguments into an array of tokens.

methods.name: required_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument is provided for an option.

methods.name: is_empty_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument string is empty.

methods.name: csum8_update
methods.description: Updates an 8-bit checksum with data.

methods.name: csum8_get
methods.description: Calculates the final 8-bit checksum value.

methods.name: csum16_update
methods.description: Updates a 16-bit checksum with data.

methods.name: csum16_get
methods.description: Calculates the final 16-bit checksum value.

methods.name: csum_init
methods.description: Initializes checksum state.

methods.name: csum_update
methods.description: Updates checksum state based on size (8 or 16 bit).

methods.name: csum_get
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum value based on size.

methods.name: write_out_data
methods.description: Writes data to output file and updates checksum.

methods.name: write_out_padding
methods.description: Writes padding bytes to output file.

methods.name: block_stat_file
methods.description: Gets file size and updates block info.

methods.name: block_writeout_hdr
methods.description: Writes block header to output file.

methods.name: block_writeout_file
methods.description: Writes block file data to output file.

methods.name: block_writeout_data
methods.description: Writes block data and padding to output file.

methods.name: block_writeout_csum
methods.description: Writes block checksum to output file.
